summary.name: GitLab
summary.one_liner: GitLab is a DevSecOps platform for source control, planning, CI/CD, security scanning and governance, positioned for teams and AI agents working on software delivery.
use_cases: host and review git code with merge requests
track issues and plan software projects
scan code and pipelines for security vulnerabilities
govern and audit changes made by humans and AI agents
connect AI coding agents to a team's repositories
summary.what_it_does: The page presents GitLab as one platform covering planning, source control, and CI/CD, with projects, releases, and code sharing a single data source. It describes security scanning, policies, and approvals running inside the pipeline, with findings shown in merge requests. It states that policies and approvals apply equally to human and agent changes, and that every agent action appears in an audit trail. It also mentions GitLab Duo for AI features, connecting MCP-compatible agents, and routing merge requests to reviewers. Much of the page is marketing language, so specific capabilities beyond these are not confirmed here.
notable: Single platform for planning, source control, CI/CD and security
Policies, approvals and scanning apply to human and AI agent changes alike
Audit trail records every agent action
Self-hostable per the awesome-selfhosted listing, MIT licensed
caveats: Pricing and plan tiers are not stated on the page
Platform list for installation comes from the awesome-selfhosted listing, not the page itself
Page is largely marketing copy with few concrete technical details
